title: Messaging — Mux Connections — payload
description: An administrator lists a mediator's live mux connections a page at a time, each with its principal, wire, and the member DIDs it carries. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

principal.description: Only connections authenticated as this principal DID.

member.description: Only connections carrying this member DID, active or not; each connection's `members` then holds that member's entry alone.

memberLimit.description: The most member entries the page carries, summed over all its connections; the responder's default is 1000. `0` returns connections without members — `memberCount` is still exact.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the requester and the other request members; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most connections to return, at most 100; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

MuxWire.title: MuxWire
MuxWire.description: The wire a mux connection speaks: `didcomm`, a DIDComm WebSocket that negotiated the `didcomm-mux` subprotocol; `tsp`, a raw-TSP WebSocket that negotiated `tsp-mux`.

MuxCoverage.title: MuxCoverage
MuxCoverage.description: Which live connections the answer covers. `allInstances`: every instance of the mediator, so a connection the answer does not list is not open anywhere. `thisInstance`: only the instance that answered; connections held by other instances of a horizontally scaled mediator are not listed, and their absence says nothing.

ConnectionMember.title: ConnectionMember
ConnectionMember.description: One member DID carried by a live mux connection.

source.description: Whether the member rides the connection through a stored grant or a session attach.

grantId.description: Present exactly when `source` is `grant`: the grant the member is attached through.

scope.description: The scope in force for the member on this connection.

expiresAt.description: When the membership lapses: the grant's effective expiry, or the attach statement's `exp`.

deliveryActive.description: False while the member's live traffic goes elsewhere — to the member DID's own direct connection, or to a newer connection of the same kind — so that this connection carries it inactive (a `superseded` member).

MuxConnection.title: MuxConnection
MuxConnection.description: One live mux connection: an authenticated connection the mediator has sent a `ready` event on and that has not closed.

sessionId.description: The connection's identifier, as its `ready` event announced it.

principal.description: The DID the connection is authenticated as.

openedAt.description: When the mediator sent the connection's `ready` event.

memberCount.description: How many members the connection carries, active or not, when the page was drawn; exact even when `members` holds fewer.

members.description: A contiguous run of the connection's members, ordered by member DID: all of them, or — when the page's member budget ran out — the first of them, the rest following on the next page under the same `sessionId`. With `member` in the request, only that member's entry.

Response.title: Messaging — Mux Connections — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/mux/connections request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/mux/connections/0.1#response.

connections.description: Live mux connections, ordered by `openedAt` then `sessionId`. The first connection of a page may continue one the previous page split.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
